text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got the stationery.
Time to head to trainingâ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The "Neko Neko Cutie Lottery"!?
They brought that lottery back!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Well... I'm probably only gonna get 3rd prize anyway. That's just the kind of luck I was born with.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, that third prize plushie... is insanely cute!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The moment for my title as the "Bronze Collector"
to truly shine... is finally here...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Winning both first and second prize...
Why does it never happen when I actually want it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... Hold on, Nature-san.
If we have '1' and '2'... what comes next?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just one more pull... If I get it then,
I can just rush off to training...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fourth prizeee!?
...Ugh, next time for sure!

"...And so, Nice Nature ended up
skipping training."
